summary: First iteration full-stack test of BUMDES Karya Waharja after code quality fixes (useCallback/useMemo/stable keys) and new 'Tambah Kode Akun' feature. Backend: 33/33 pytest passed. Frontend: all critical flows work (login 3 roles, dashboard KPIs+charts+units table, COA create new account, transactions, reports tabs, per-unit, revenue share, mitra, unit-usaha, users). RBAC verified: pengelola sidebar correctly hides Laporan Keuangan / Bagi Hasil / Kode Akun / Kelola Pengguna. No regressions detected.

issues: Dev-mode console shows React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Root cause: dev-instrumentation (data-ve-dynamic / x-ve wrappers) injecting a <span display:contents> inside <option>, which is invalid HTML. This is caused by the visual-editing dev instrumentation, not by the app code (App.js/COAPage.jsx render plain <option>{a.code} - {a.name}</option>). Non-blocking in production build, but noisy in dev.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~800 lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, accounts, transactions, reports, pdf) for maintainability.
PDF endpoints share a lot of boilerplate (build/table/header). A small helper builder for row-lists would reduce duplication (DRY).
In _calc_balances, unbounded to_list(20000) - fine for MVP but for scale should paginate/aggregate in Mongo.

create_transaction/create_mitra do not restrict pengelola from creating in other units on POST body-level (transaction is forced to user's unit which is correct; mitra POST does not enforce - any authenticated user can POST any unit_usaha_id). Consider forcing unit_usaha_id for pengelola on mitra create too.
Backend seed: default users seeded only if users collection is empty; adding a new user manually and then wiping only default admin would leave app without admin. Acceptable for MVP.

Frontend dev-mode HTML validity: <select> option renders text plus injected span from visual-editor instrumentation. Not app bug, but if this ships to production build should verify it's stripped by build.
